newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's backs marketing partner Disney.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's backs marketing partner Disney.

text.p: McDonald's Corp said Thursday it stood behind its marketing partner Walt Disney Co, which is the target of a boycott by the Southern Baptists who claim the entertainment giant is promoting homosexuality.
"The Walt Disney Co is an outstanding organization with an excellent, well-deserved reputation for promoting family entertainment," McDonald's spokesman Charles Ebeling said.

McDonald's and Walt Disney have a 10-year exclusive marketing alliance based on Disney's family entertainment. For example, McDonald's now has a promotional tie-in to Disney's animated Hercules movie.
McDonald's is wrapping up another promotion to sell music collections from classic Disney films, with part of the proceeds going to Ronald McDonald House Charities for children.

On Wednesday, the Southern Baptist convention, the largest Protestant denomination in the United States, voted a sweeping boycott of Disney's theme parks, stores and its subsidiaries, including ABC television and radio.

Southern Baptists protested Disney's offering of health benefits to the partners of homosexual employees and allowing "Gay Days" organized by gay rights groups at its theme parks. Critics also blasted Disney's ABC television for the popular sitcom, Ellen, which features a character who, like the actress portraying her, is a lesbian.
Some Southern Baptist delegates had proposed action also be taken against McDonald's and Wal-Mart Stores Inc because they sell or promote Disney products, but no decison was made on Wednesday.
